name: Cross Encoder Reranker
description: Rerank a short candidate list with a cross-encoder model, importing sentence-transformers lazily so the module loads and fails cleanly without it.
install: Install the optional dependencies first with: uv add sentence-transformers
missing_dependency_message: cross-encoder-reranker requires 'sentence-transformers', which is not installed. Install it with: uv add sentence-transformers
